title: Spool: Low-Latency Streaming Inference for Hybrid Vision-Language Models
summary: Applications such as visual accessibility agents and robotics require answering questions about recent video content promptly, over a bounded window of past frames (e.g., the last two minutes). Hybrid vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave attention with linear recurrent layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), are attractive for this setting, but maintaining a sliding window is expensive. The reason is that recurrent layers combine all past frames into a shared state, so expiring old frames normally requires re-running the entire window through the model. We observe that the recurrent update is affine in the state with input-dependent coefficients, so the effect of each frame can be captured as a transformation that composes associatively. We present Spool, a training-free framework that caches per-frame state transformations and composes them efficiently as the window advances, removing expired frames from each recurrent layer's state without replaying frames through the backbone. Removal is exact within each layer; as with key-value eviction in attention, expired frames can retain residual influence through the cached inputs computed by earlier layers. We design a dedicated data structure and GPU kernels to achieve low caching and composition overhead. Across five open-source hybrid VLMs and four video reasoning benchmarks, Spool achieves the lowest p95 time-to-first-token in all 20 model-benchmark tests, reducing it by a geometric mean of $6.6\times$ over the faster of two recent vLLM baselines, while improving accuracy by 2.3 percentage points on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Spool框架，通过缓存并组合每帧的状态变换，实现了无需重放即可在混合VLM中精确移除过期视频帧，从而大幅降低了滑动窗口视频问答的延迟并提升了准确率。
AI.motivation: 在需要快速回答近期视频内容的应用中，混合视觉语言模型（VLM）的循环层将所有过去帧合并为共享状态，导致传统滑动窗口机制必须在过期旧帧时将整个窗口重新运行模型，计算开销极大。
AI.method: 提出Spool，一种无需训练的框架。利用循环更新在状态中具有仿射关系的特性，将每帧影响捕获为可结合的变换并缓存；随着窗口推进，通过专用数据结构和GPU内核高效组合这些变换，直接移除过期帧而无需通过主干网络重放。
AI.result: 在5个开源混合VLM和4个视频推理基准的20项测试中，Spool在所有测试中均取得了最低的p95首个令牌生成时间，较vLLM基线几何平均降低6.6倍，且平均准确率提升2.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Spool有效解决了混合VLM在滑动窗口视频推理中高昂的计算开销问题，在显著提升响应速度的同时保持了甚至提高了模型精度，为实时视频应用提供了高效的解决方案。

title: StringQFT: A Multiuse Textbook Resource for AI-Assisted Theoretical Physics
summary: We present StringQFT as a textbook collection for string constructions of quantum field theory and as infrastructure for AI-assisted theoretical physics. The collection comprises 18 volumes, 190 chapters and 3,795 pages, covering brane probes, brane webs, geometric engineering, F-theory constructions, wrapped M5-branes and exact worldsheet constructions. Its open-book benchmark inventory contains 1,073 items, including 499 with automatic finite-answer checking. For retrieval-augmented generation, it provides 1,371 section records linked to textbook sources and PDF locations, together with a local lexical retriever. Training-data preparation is illustrated by 21 private, source-linked examples. For agents, it exposes 19 calculation tools with specified inputs and finite domains, connecting tool use to textbook derivations. We illustrate these uses through specific questions, retrieved passages and finite calculations. The textbook collection and accompanying resources are available at https://github.com/xingyang-yu/StringQFT.
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures. Companion paper to an 18-volume textbook collection. Textbook PDFs: https://xingyangyu.com/textbook/

AI.tldr: StringQFT是一个用于量子场论弦构造的综合教科书集合及AI辅助理论物理的基础设施。
AI.motivation: 旨在为AI辅助理论物理（特别是量子场论的弦构造领域）提供系统性的基础资源与算法基础设施。
AI.method: 构建了包含18卷、190章的教科书集合，并整合了基准测试清单、检索增强生成（RAG）记录、训练数据示例以及面向智能体的计算工具。
AI.result: 该资源包含3,795页内容、1,073个基准测试项（其中499项支持自动答案检查）、1,371条RAG记录、21个训练数据示例和19个计算工具，并通过具体问题和计算展示了其应用。
AI.conclusion: StringQFT成功将理论物理文献与AI基础设施相结合，提供开源资源以促进该领域的未来研究与工具开发。

title: Equilibrium Statistics and Stability in Random Two-Population and Three-Population Evolutionary Games
summary: Multi-population matrix evolutionary games provide a framework for studying adaptation and strategic interactions among heterogeneous agents. When payoffs are uncertain, however, analysing a specified game does not reveal how frequently different evolutionary outcomes occur or how their probabilities depend on modelling assumptions. We study two- and three-population games with two strategies per population and both within- and between-population pairwise interactions, with payoffs fixed during each evolutionary trajectory. For two populations, we derive equilibrium-existence probabilities and analytical stability results for generic games and three structured classes: diversity, exclusive, and avoidance games. For generic two-population games, independent Gaussian sampling of payoff entries and of replicator coefficients produces different equilibrium statistics. Interaction structure further distinguishes coexistence from attraction: diversity and exclusive games share the same interior-existence probability, but only exclusive games admit asymptotically stable interior equilibria. Avoidance games admit transversely attracting equilibrium families without locally asymptotically stable individual points. For generic three-population games under independent payoff sampling, we obtain existence probabilities for all equilibrium types and joint existence-and-stability probabilities for boundary equilibria. Monte Carlo simulations support the analytical predictions and quantify multistability, while phase portraits illustrate initial-condition dependence. Under the same Gaussian payoff-sampling protocol, simulations show a lower frequency of fully mixed equilibria but a higher frequency of multistability for three populations than for two.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了收益不确定条件下的多种群矩阵演化博弈，推导并验证了二种群和三种群博弈的均衡存在概率与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 在收益不确定时，单一博弈分析无法揭示不同演化结果的发生频率及其对模型假设的依赖性，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 研究每群两策略的二、三种群博弈，利用独立高斯采样收益，解析推导通用及结构化（多样性、排他性、回避）博弈的均衡存在与稳定性概率，并用蒙特卡洛模拟和相图验证。
AI.result: 二种群中交互结构区分了共存与吸引，多样性博弈与排他性博弈内部均衡存在概率相同但仅后者渐近稳定；三种群模拟显示完全混合均衡频率更低，而多稳定性频率更高。
AI.conclusion: 模型假设（如收益分布和互动结构）显著影响演化结果的概率特征，且三种群博弈比二种群博弈具有更高的多稳态倾向。

title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
summary: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-improve? In this paper we study an autonomous paradigm in which, given basic primitives, resources, and a general goal for self-improvement, agents construct their own self-learning algorithm for context-based optimization. Using the setting of gameplay as a testbed, a frozen LLM agent is given a compute budget and tools for collecting experience and updating text documents, and allowed to freely experiment without an externally imposed loop or access to real-world data. We find that sufficiently capable models do self-improve under these conditions, demonstrating strategies that align with classic cognitive frameworks for self-regulated learning and constructs from machine learning literature on self-generated curricula. Furthermore, we study the extent to which the learned text artifacts transfer to external benchmarks, observing improvement across different game horizons, mechanics, and 3D navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了LLM智能体能否在没有外部干预的情况下自主构建自我学习算法并实现自我提升。
AI.motivation: 随着模型能力的提升与自我改进方法的增加，旨在探究模型是否仍需人类指定如何自我提升，还是能够自主优化自身学习过程。
AI.method: 在游戏环境中，为冻结的LLM智能体提供计算预算、经验收集与文本更新工具及总体目标，允许其在不依赖外部循环或真实数据的情况下自由实验并自主构建学习算法。
AI.result: 能力足够的模型能够自主实现自我提升，其策略与经典的自我调节学习及自生成课程理论一致；生成的文本产物在外部基准测试中表现出跨游戏时长、机制和3D导航的泛化提升。
AI.conclusion: 足够能力的LLM无需外部强加学习循环即可实现自主自我提升，且习得的知识能有效迁移至外部任务。

title: Identifying and Repairing Energy Smells with Agent Skills
summary: Energy smells are inefficient implementations that waste energy. Once code reaches production, these smells become costlier and riskier to fix, so energy efficiency checks should shift left, i.e., move earlier in the development lifecycle, to where code is written. Existing energy smell tools rely on fixed static rules and do not measure energy savings, whereas LLM-based optimizers mostly target execution time and rarely ground their changes in concrete smell definitions. To address both limitations, we present DR. GREENS, an agent skill that detects and repairs energy smells in Python code within the developer's coding environment. The skill grounds the coding agent in our taxonomy of 12 energy smells and 65 root causes, augmented with repair guidance drawn from 230 measured cases. The skill also encapsulates a static analyzer and an independent verifier to confirm behavior preservation and energy saving for each attempted repair. We evaluated DR. GREENS in 18 sessions on three open-source repositories, with two models and three skill configurations. Of the 258 measured repairs, 68.6% saved energy, with a median saving of 24.9%. Compared with a baseline skill that lacks the taxonomy, the full skill found more energy smells with verified savings in all three repositories with both models. DR. GREENS helps developers detect energy hotspots and fix them reliably without altering program behavior, which makes energy-efficient development more feasible.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了DR. GREENS，一个在开发环境中检测和修复Python代码能耗坏味道的智能体技能。
AI.motivation: 现有的能耗检测工具依赖静态规则且不测量能耗节省，而基于大语言模型（LLM）的优化器多针对执行时间且缺乏具体的坏味道定义。为了尽早（左移）解决代码中的能耗问题，降低生产环境中的修复成本和风险，需要一种结合两者优势的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为DR. GREENS的智能体技能，该技能基于包含12种能耗坏味道和65个根因的分类法，并引入了从230个测量案例中提取的修复指导。同时，它封装了静态分析器和独立验证器，以确认每次修复都保持了行为一致并实现了能耗节省。
AI.result: 在三个开源代码库的18次评估中，258次修复里有68.6%实现了能耗节省，中位数节省率为24.9%。与缺少分类法的基线技能相比，配备完整技能的模型在所有测试库和模型中均发现了更多具备验证性节能效果的能耗坏味道。
AI.conclusion: DR. GREENS 能够帮助开发者在编写代码时可靠地检测并修复能耗热点而不改变程序行为，使得在开发早期实现高能效编码更加可行。

title: Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI): A Federated Identity, Trust, Attestation, and Accountability Architecture for Cross-Organization Autonomous AI Agents
summary: AI agents increasingly collaborate across organizational boundaries, invoking tools and interacting with agents operated by independent entities. Although existing agent frameworks support planning and coordination, they lack a common mechanism for verifying cross-organizational agent identity, execution integrity, and authorization. We propose the Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI), a framework-independent security architecture built on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), and remote attestation. ATI establishes federated trust through peer organizational certificate authorities (AgentCAs), eliminating the need for a shared root authority. Before executing requests, ATI validates agent certificates, verifies approved model, tool, and system-prompt configurations, and enforces authorization through three policy checks. We implement ATI as an external security enforcement layer that integrates with existing agent frameworks without modifying their underlying models. We evaluate ATI in a simulated federation of eight organizations using six agent frameworks, each deploying a five-agent team. Security experiments involve two organizations and assess 14 attack scenarios and six benign tasks across five agent models, using five attack variations and three repetitions per variation. A panel of judge models evaluates the experimental outcomes. With all enforcement mechanisms enabled, attack containment increases from 43% to 84% (40% to 80% for the 11 attack scenarios evaluated consistently across all configurations), while enforcement introduces approximately 174 microseconds of overhead per request. ATI is released as an open-source, framework-independent package that uses IETF WIMSE workload token formats for identity and request verification and Entity Attestation Tokens for model, tool, and system-prompt integrity verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI)，一种基于PKI、零信任架构与远程证明的框架无关安全架构，用于验证跨组织AI代理的身份、执行完整性与授权。
AI.motivation: 现有代理框架支持规划与协调，但缺乏统一的机制来验证跨组织代理身份、执行完整性及授权，存在安全隐患。
AI.method: 通过peer组织证书颁发机构建立联邦信任，执行代理证书验证、模型/工具/系统提示配置校验及三项授权策略检查；以外部安全强制层实现，兼容现有框架；采用IETF WIMSE工作负载令牌与实体证明令牌。
AI.result: 在8组织模拟联邦、6框架实验中，全部强制机制开启时攻击遏制率从43%提升至84%（一致评估场景下从40%提升至80%），每请求开销约174微秒。
AI.conclusion: ATI作为开源框架无关方案，有效提升跨组织代理协作安全性，且不修改底层模型，实现低开销的身份与完整性验证。

title: Learned versus Kinematic Trajectory Prediction under Reduced Observation Frequency
summary: Trajectory prediction models for automated driving are usually trained on data with a fixed sampling frequency, while positions received via vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication arrive at 1-10 Hz. We study whether a learned predictor that uses only the observation history keeps its advantage over constant velocity (CV) and constant acceleration (CA) models when the history frequency drops. On the Argoverse 2 motion forecasting dataset, the 5 s history of the focal agent was downsampled from 10 Hz to 5, 2, and 1 Hz, and the 6 s future was predicted without maps or neighboring agents. An LSTM-based recurrent neural network (RNN) trained for each frequency was compared with the same network trained at 10 Hz and applied to sparse histories after linear interpolation. Hypotheses and thresholds were fixed before training, the main RNNs were trained with ten seeds each, and results on 24,984 test scenarios have bootstrap confidence intervals over scenarios and seeds. The average displacement error of the frequency-specific RNN grew by 3.1% at 5 Hz, 10.1% at 2 Hz, and 20.3% at 1 Hz. Contrary to our hypothesis, its advantage over the better kinematic model did not vanish on straight motion and was 24-30% on both straight motion and turns at every frequency, while for pedestrians CV was more accurate. The 10 Hz model with interpolation was at most 1.3% less accurate than the frequency-specific model down to 2 Hz but 11.5% less accurate at 1 Hz. Each hypothesis was only partly supported.
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code and per-scenario results: https://github.com/nleaxy/learned-vs-kinematic-trajectory-prediction

AI.tldr: 本文研究了当历史观测频率降低时，自动驾驶中的学习型轨迹预测模型相比运动学模型是否仍能保持优势。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶轨迹预测模型通常在固定采样频率数据上训练，而V2X通信接收的位置信号频率仅为1-10 Hz。本文旨在解决当历史数据频率下降时，学习型预测器相比恒速（CV）和恒加速（CA）模型能否保持优势的问题。
AI.method: 在Argoverse 2数据集上，将5秒历史轨迹从10 Hz降采样至5、2和1 Hz以预测6秒未来轨迹。对比了针对各频率训练的LSTM网络与经线性插值处理的10 Hz模型，并在24,984个测试场景中使用10个随机种子计算置信区间。
AI.result: 特定频率RNN的误差随频率降低而增加（5 Hz增3.1%，2 Hz增10.1%，1 Hz增20.3%）。其在车辆直线和转弯运动中始终比运动学模型准确24-30%，但在行人预测上CV模型更准。带插值的10 Hz模型在2 Hz及以上时精度至多低1.3%，但在1 Hz时低11.5%。
AI.conclusion: 研究假设仅得到部分支持；学习型模型在车辆轨迹预测中保持优势，但行人预测不及CV模型；线性插值策略在频率不低于2 Hz时有效，但在1 Hz时表现显著下降。

title: WoRD: Diffusion-Based Posterior Inference for Online Goal Recognition
summary:
Goal recognition is the task of inferring an agent's intended goal from its observed behavior. Most existing work focuses on high-level symbolic recognition, abstracting away the continuous motion through which agents reach their goal. Methods that do reason over continuous trajectories rely on an explicit dynamics model that is hard to acquire and rarely transfers across settings. Neither approach explicitly learns how agents move toward each candidate goal, limiting accuracy on ambiguous trajectory prefixes where such knowledge is most needed.
  We present WoRD (Waypoint Recognition with Diffusion), which uses a learned trajectory prior to infer the agent's goal from partial observations. At each step, WoRD runs one warm-started denoising chain per candidate goal, steers each chain toward the observed trajectory through a closed-form log-likelihood gradient, and reweights the resulting samples by Bayes' rule into a calibrated posterior over goals. We evaluate WoRD on simulated robot settings, pedestrian trajectories, and vehicle trajectories using four metrics targeting distinct failure modes. Across all three settings, the same inference procedure preserves calibrated multimodal beliefs through ambiguous prefixes where filter- and classifier-based observers collapse to a single mode or grow overconfident.
comment: Accepted at the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

AI.tldr: 本文提出WoRD框架，利用学习到的轨迹先验和扩散模型从部分观测中连续推断智能体目标，在模糊轨迹中保持校准的多模态信念。
AI.motivation: 现有的目标识别方法多采用高层符号化抽象，忽略了连续运动，或依赖难以获取且难以跨场景迁移的显式动力学模型，导致在模糊轨迹前缀上缺乏对智能体运动方式的先验知识，限制了识别准确率。
AI.method: 提出基于扩散模型的航点识别方法（WoRD）。为每个候选目标运行热启动去噪链，通过闭式对数似然梯度将去噪链引导向观测轨迹，并利用贝叶斯准则对采样结果进行重加权，生成目标上的校准后验分布。
AI.result: 在机器人仿真、行人和车辆轨迹场景的测试中，面对模糊轨迹前缀，WoRD能够维持校准的多模态信念；而基于滤波器和分类器的方法则会坍缩为单一模式或变得过度自信。
AI.conclusion: WoRD通过学习轨迹先验结合扩散模型进行推理，有效解决了连续轨迹中模糊目标识别的难题，在多种动态场景下实现了更准确、鲁棒且校准的多模态目标预测。

title: Inference after coding agents
summary: Empirical research is changing rapidly as AI coding agents are becoming increasingly proficient in every step of it, from writing code to manipulating data. We argue that while the potential of coding agents for science is vast, their use in hypothesis testing poses a substantial threat to classical inference, as these agents enable a supercharged form of selective inference. In particular, we argue that coding agents carrying out empirical research introduce a new type of post-selection inference that combines human-like, open-ended search over an implicit space of estimators with programmatic replayability of both the selection and the estimation process. Indeed, we find that on simulated data with zero effects, four frontier agents report significant p-values between 54% and 98% of the time when asked to produce a compelling finding. We propose a simple procedure for detecting and correcting these distortions. After an agent has completed its analysis, we reset and replay it on subsamples of the data to estimate the agent's relative probability of selecting that analysis when it looks statistically favorable. For agents with stable selection behavior, the resulting corrected test is asymptotically valid and consistent conditional on selection. Importantly, the correction is learned from the black-box agent's actual choices rather than a model of how it searches, so it remains valid even as AI technology continues to evolve rapidly. In simulations, the correction robustly lowers the high false rejection rates to near the nominal 5%. We illustrate the method on applications from two published papers.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI编程代理在实证研究中导致的过度选择性推断问题，并提出了一种通过重放代理在数据子样本上的行为来检测和纠正p值扭曲的方法。
AI.motivation: AI编程代理在假设检验中进行开放式搜索，引入了一种新型的后选择推断问题。这导致在零效应数据上代理仍频繁报告显著p值，严重威胁经典统计推断的有效性。
AI.method: 在代理完成分析后，将其重置并在数据子样本上重放其过程。通过估计代理在结果统计上显著时选择特定分析路径的相对概率，对推断结果进行检测和校正。该校正基于代理的实际黑盒选择行为，无需对其内部搜索机制建模。
AI.result: 在零效应模拟数据上，四个前沿AI代理在54%至98%的情况下报告了显著p值。应用所提校正方法后，错误拒绝率被稳健地降低至接近名义水平5%。该方法还在两篇已发表论文的应用中得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: 基于代理实际选择行为的重放校正方法，为具有稳定选择行为的代理提供了渐近有效且一致的条件推断。该方法不依赖AI内部模型，能够适应技术的持续快速演进，有效保障了AI辅助科学研究的统计可靠性。

title: Capability Composition in Heterogeneous Teams via Barrier-Guided Diffusion Sampling
summary: The agents in a heterogeneous team can cooperate to accomplish tasks that exceed their individual capabilities. The team trajectories for a cooperative task can be generated by a generative model, provided that the model has been trained on demonstrations of the agents cooperating. Yet, demonstrations of cooperation are costly and may not exist for tasks that the team has never performed. The conditions under which the agents can combine their capabilities, however, are physical properties of the team and are known before any demonstration is collected. We encode the conditions as constraints on the team trajectories, and we enforce the constraints while sampling from generative models trained on demonstrations of each agent alone. We prove that the proposed method can generate every team trajectory that satisfies the constraints, although the demonstrations contain no cooperation. Hence the constraints determine which team trajectories can be generated, and the demonstrations determine how likely each team trajectory is. Numerical results on two cooperative tasks show the effectiveness of the method, which generates cooperative team trajectories that satisfy the constraints and requires no retraining when agents join or leave the team. Finally, we implement the method on a multi-robot testbed.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合物理约束与单智能体生成模型的方法，无需昂贵的团队协作演示即可生成异构团队的协作轨迹。
AI.motivation: 异构团队协作任务的轨迹生成通常依赖于协作演示数据进行训练，但此类数据获取成本高昂，且对于团队从未执行过的新任务往往并不存在。
AI.method: 将智能体能力结合的物理条件编码为团队轨迹的约束，并在从仅基于单智能体独立演示训练的生成模型采样时强制执行这些约束。约束决定可生成的轨迹集合，而单智能体演示决定各轨迹的生成概率。
AI.result: 理论证明该方法可生成所有满足约束的协作轨迹；在两个协作任务及多机器人物理测试平台上的数值与实际结果验证了其有效性，且在智能体加入或离开团队时无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过引入物理约束解除了对团队协作演示的依赖，支持动态的团队组成，为异构多智能体系统的协作轨迹生成提供了具备理论保证且可实际部署的解决方案。

title: The Hidden Cost of MoE Diffusion Decoding: Profiling and Fixing the Sampler
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) decode by iteratively denoising a full canvas of tokens, so every forward pass runs a per-token sampling and stopping pipeline over the entire canvas-by-vocabulary logits tensor. We profile single-user decoding of a 26B-parameter diffusion Mixture-of-Experts model on a bandwidth-bound edge accelerator (NVIDIA GB10) and report a result that is easy to miss: after weight quantisation, this logits pipeline, not the expert GEMMs, is the single largest consumer of decode time. Unlike autoregressive decoding, where sampling touches one position's logits per committed token, diffusion decoding processes S times as many logit entries per output token, where S is the number of denoising steps. We show this pipeline is largely redundant or fusable and remove it in two lossless tiers: a bit-exact tier whose output is byte-identical to the reference decoder, and an accuracy-parity tier using a fused single-pass entropy kernel and Gumbel-max sampling. Combined with a W4A16 expert kernel, the full stack reaches 2.4-2.7 times end-to-end speedup over bf16 at unchanged benchmark accuracy on GSM8K, HumanEval, and MATH, on a single 273 GB/s device. We confirm the finding on a second, independently built diffusion MoE (LLaDA2.0-mini: pipeline 28.8% of decode, fused W4A16 3.3 times at accuracy parity) and show it disappears on a dense diffusion model (3.6%). The cost is specific to MoE diffusion, where quantisation makes the backbone cheap. Code and quantised weights are released.

AI.tldr: 本文发现掩码扩散MoE模型在权重量化后，logits处理流水线成为解码的主要瓶颈，并提出无损融合与优化方法实现了2.4至2.7倍的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型在全画布去噪时，其逐token的采样与停止流水线在权重量化后取代专家GEMM成为解码时间的最大消耗源。由于扩散解码处理的logit条目数是自回归解码的S倍（S为去噪步数），导致该流水线存在大量冗余，消耗巨大带宽与算力。
AI.method: 提出两层无损优化方案以移除冗余流水线：一是输出比特完全一致的精确层（bit-exact tier）；二是使用融合单次熵核和Gumbel-max采样的精度对等层（accuracy-parity tier）。同时结合W4A16专家内核进一步降低主干网络开销。
AI.result: 在单台带宽受限的边缘设备上，结合W4A16专家内核，该完整方案在GSM8K、HumanEval和MATH基准上保持精度不变，实现了2.4至2.7倍的端到端加速。在另一个独立构建的MoE模型上也验证了该发现（解码流水线占比28.8%，融合W4A16加速3.3倍），并证明该开销在稠密扩散模型中并不显著（仅占3.6%）。
AI.conclusion: logits流水线的冗余开销是量化后MoE扩散模型特有的核心瓶颈。通过融合与优化该流水线，可以在不牺牲精度的前提下，显著提升边缘设备上的端到端解码性能。

title: DRAMA: Dissecting Attention Redundancy for Accelerating Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text through iterative masked denoising with bidirectional attention, offering a compelling alternative to autoregressive vision-language modeling. However, each denoising step requires a full forward pass over long multimodal sequences in which visual tokens dominate the sequence length, and a fixed step budget further compounds this quadratic per-step cost. Existing inference acceleration approaches for multimodal dLLMs characterize attention redundancy implicitly, motivating designs from isolated attention visualizations rather than from measurement. We close this gap with DRAMA, a training-free acceleration framework grounded in a systematic dissection of attention redundancy in multimodal dLLMs. By probing attention tensors along spatial and temporal axes, we reveal two persistent redundancy structures: (i) attention mass consistently concentrates on a sparse subset of visual tokens, and (ii) attention distributions rapidly stabilize across denoising steps after an initial formation phase. These findings motivate two complementary mechanisms: Spatial-Redundancy-Aware Visual Token Pruning (SVTP) and Sufficiency-Guided Adaptive Stopping (SGAS). Together, DRAMA achieves an average 18.67 times inference speedup across six vision-language benchmarks without training, architectural modification, or attention caching, while maintaining competitive accuracy. Our results establish a strong, measurement-grounded acceleration baseline for multimodal dLLM inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRAMA框架，通过系统测量多模态扩散大语言模型中注意力冗余结构，实现无需训练的18.67倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 多模态扩散大语言模型每步去噪需对长多模态序列进行完整前向传播，视觉token主导序列长度导致二次方计算成本高昂；现有加速方法缺乏系统测量，仅基于孤立注意力可视化设计，存在显著改进空间。
AI.method: 沿空间和时间轴系统探测注意力张量，揭示两种持续性冗余结构：注意力质量集中于稀疏视觉token子集、去噪步中注意力分布在初始形成阶段后快速稳定；据此提出空间冗余感知视觉token剪枝（SVTP）与充分性引导自适应停止（SGAS）两个互补机制。
AI.result: 在六个视觉语言基准上平均实现18.67倍推理加速，无需训练、架构修改或注意力缓存，同时保持竞争性准确率。
AI.conclusion: 建立了基于测量的多模态dLLM推理加速基准，证明系统分析注意力冗余结构可有效指导加速方法设计，为后续研究提供了强基线。

title: Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation: Training-Free Long-Context Extrapolation for Diffusion LLMs
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate by iteratively unmasking tokens with bidirectional attention, but rotary position embeddings (RoPE) still confine them to a fixed pretraining window. Existing training-free extrapolation, notably LongLLaDA, copies NTK-based RoPE scaling from autoregressive (AR) models and applies one static, length-only transform at every position and denoising step. That transplant ignores a signal unique to dLLMs: the evolving mask pattern of the partially decoded sequence. We propose Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation (MPPA). MPPA linearly interpolates indices into the pretrained window, then adds a per-position, per-step offset from cumulative mask density. The offset restores rotary phase resolution that interpolation collapses, and it shrinks as tokens are committed, so late steps see near-clean interpolated geometry. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct at twice its 4096-token window, MPPA reduces perplexity from 19.51 under standard decoding to 3.12 at 8192 tokens, below the in-window figure, with 100% passkey retrieval and unchanged needle-in-a-haystack accuracy. These preliminary $2\times$ results motivate mask-conditioned position engineering as a diffusion-native path to long-context generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出掩码模式位置增强（MPPA），利用扩散语言模型独有的掩码演化信号实现免训练的上下文窗口外推。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）受限于RoPE的固定预训练窗口，现有免训练外推方法（如LongLLaDA）直接移植自回归模型的NTK缩放策略，忽略了dLLMs解码过程中掩码模式动态演化的独特信号，导致外推效果不佳。
AI.method: MPPA首先将位置索引线性插值至预训练窗口内，随后基于累积掩码密度为每个位置和每个去噪步骤添加偏移量。该偏移量恢复了插值所坍缩的旋转相位分辨率，并随着token被确定而逐渐缩小，使后期去噪步骤接近干净的插值几何结构。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上将上下文窗口扩展2倍至8192 token时，MPPA将困惑度从标准解码的19.51降至3.12（低于窗口内原始值），passkey检索准确率达100%，needle-in-a-haystack准确率保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 初步的2倍外推结果表明，基于掩码条件的位置工程是扩散语言模型实现长上下文生成的原生有效路径，值得进一步探索。

title: Beyond the Prompt: Leveraging Pre-Decoding States for Jailbreak Detection in dLLMs
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a strong alternative to autoregressive models, generating responses by iteratively refining masked tokens in parallel rather than decoding sequentially. While enabling more efficient and flexible inference, dLLMs remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, including recent attacks that exploit properties unique to dLLMs such as bidirectional conditioning and parallel masked-token refinement. In this work, we show that these same properties also expose a safety-relevant detection surface absent from standard autoregressive decoding: even when a jailbreak is difficult to identify from prompt representations alone, it can still be detected from hidden states over masked response positions before any tokens are generated. By training linear classifiers on prompt and pre-decoding response representations, we empirically show that neither view strictly dominates, with each detecting attacks that the other misses. We introduce $\texttt{ReFuse}$ (Representation Fusion), an inference-time detector that fuses the sigmoid harmfulness scores of the two classifiers. Without modifying model weights or the decoding procedure, $\texttt{ReFuse}$ reduces average ASR across multiple jailbreaks from 63.29% for the undefended model and 11.27% for a prompt-only classifier to 3.31%, while keeping average benign refusal on standard utility benchmarks below 1% on LLaDA-8B. Together, these results establish $\texttt{ReFuse}$ as a lightweight jailbreak detector for dLLMs that improves safety beyond prompt-only detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReFuse，一种融合提示和预解码响应表示的推理时检测器，用于防御扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）的越狱攻击。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型虽具高效推理能力，但仍易受越狱攻击，包括利用dLLM特有属性（双向条件化和并行掩码token细化）的攻击。仅从提示表示检测越狱存在不足，需要更全面的检测手段。
AI.method: 利用dLLM独特的预解码阶段隐藏状态作为检测信号，分别在提示表示和掩码响应位置表示上训练线性分类器，并通过ReFuse在推理时融合两者的sigmoid有害性分数，无需修改模型权重或解码流程。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B上，ReFuse将多种越狱攻击的平均攻击成功率（ASR）从未防御的63.29%和仅提示分类器的11.27%降至3.31%，同时在标准效用基准上的平均良性拒绝率低于1%。
AI.conclusion: ReFuse作为一种轻量级dLLM越狱检测器，通过融合提示与预解码响应表示实现了优于仅提示检测的安全性，且不影响模型效用。

title: PBPO: Prefix-Block Policy Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) commonly decode responses by proceeding autoregressively across blocks while iteratively denoising multiple tokens within each block. This structure makes block-level policy optimization a natural adaptation of autoregressive policy optimization. However, the exact likelihood of a completed block is intractable because it marginalizes over the intermediate states and reveal orders of the denoising process. To realize the block-level formulation, we construct a prefix-block state and use a single model evaluation to define a factorized one-step surrogate for the block likelihood. The resulting block surrogate ratio is a product of its token surrogate ratios, allowing variation at individual positions to propagate across the entire block before clipping. We therefore introduce Prefix-Block Policy Optimization (PBPO), which preserves block-level conditioning but applies surrogate importance weighting and clipping separately to each token. PBPO further diversifies repeated updates by resampling corrupted views of the prompt and revealed prefix, a design motivated by masked-dLLM pre-training. Under our analysis assumptions, block-product weighting amplifies the variance of gradient contributions relative to token-local weighting. Across two LLaDA-family initializations, six benchmarks, and three generation lengths, PBPO achieves competitive performance against existing dLLM RL methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Prefix-Block Policy Optimization (PBPO)方法，通过分词器级别的替代重要性加权和裁剪来实现扩散大语言模型的块级策略优化。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型的块级策略优化中，完整块的似然值因需对中间状态和揭示顺序进行边际化而难以计算，本文旨在解决这一不可解性问题。
AI.method: 构建前缀块状态，使用单次模型评估定义块似然的分阶单步替代，使块替代比率为各token替代比率的乘积；保持块级条件的同时对每个token单独应用替代重要性加权和裁剪，并通过重新采样提示和已揭示前缀的损坏视图来多样化重复更新。
AI.result: 在两个LLaDA家族初始化、六个基准测试和三种生成长度的实验中，PBPO与现有dLLM强化学习方法取得了有竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: PBPO为dLLM提供了一种有效的策略优化方案，在保持块级条件化的同时实现了token级优化，为扩散语言模型的训练改进提供了新方向。

title: VIGOR: Visual Gain Ordering for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: Multimodal discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate responses through iterative mask prediction and offer a promising alternative to autoregressive large vision-language models. However, they still suffer from hallucination, producing outputs that are plausible under language priors but insufficiently grounded in the image. We argue that hallucination in multimodal dLLMs is not only a token prediction problem, but also a premature commitment problem: during iterative denoising, some masked positions are unmasked too early because their confidence is driven more by language priors than by visual evidence, and these early commitments can bias later generation. To address this issue, we propose Visual Gain Ordering (VIGOR), a training-free and plug-and-play inference strategy that reorders masked positions according to counterfactual visual evidence. At each denoising step, VIGOR compares the confidence of each candidate token under the original image-conditioned pass and an additional visual-ablation pass, and prioritizes positions whose predictions are more strongly supported by the image. Experiments on LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO show that VIGOR consistently reduces hallucination and improves multimodal reasoning performance across benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/THU-BPM/Vigor.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练推理策略VIGOR，通过基于反事实视觉证据重排掩码位置来缓解多模态离散扩散语言模型的幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态离散扩散语言模型在生成时存在“过早承诺问题”，即部分掩码位置过早去掩码是因为过度依赖语言先验而非视觉证据，从而引发幻觉并影响后续生成。
AI.method: 提出一种即插即用的免训练推理策略VIGOR，在每步去噪时对比候选token在原图像条件和视觉消融条件下的置信度，优先预测视觉证据支持更强的位置。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-V和Lumina-DiMOO基准测试中，VIGOR持续降低了幻觉并提升了多模态推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于反事实视觉证据调整生成顺序，VIGOR有效解决了多模态dLLM的过早承诺问题，改善了输出的视觉基础。

title: Step-dLLM: Adaptive Step-aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Diffusion LLM Inference
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate tokens in parallel via iterative denoising, but their bidirectional attention prevents the KV caching used by autoregressive models and recomputes the full attention map at every step, incurring quadratic per-step cost. Existing sparse attention methods for dLLMs construct a sparse mask after an initial full-attention warm-up and reuse it for the remaining steps, while allocating the sparsity budget uniformly across heads. We argue both choices ignore key structural properties of attention in dLLMs: empirically, attention patterns are only locally consistent across steps and shift abruptly at certain transitions, and different heads concentrate their attention mass to very different extents. To this end, we design Step-dLLM, which periodically refreshes a block-sparse mask at anchor steps along the denoising trajectory and reuses it within each locally consistent interval, while employing a head-adaptive global budget that more aggressively compresses heads with concentrated attention. Backed by a fused IO-aware Triton kernel for block-sparse attention, Step-dLLM applies to pre-trained LLaDA-1.5 and Dream-7B-Instruct without retraining, achieving a 2.78x end-to-end speedup over dense FlashAttention on LLaDA-1.5 at 8K context with 256 denoising steps and 90% sparsity, while improving the accuracy-latency trade-off over prior sparse-attention methods.

AI.tldr: Step-dLLM通过动态刷新块稀疏掩码并采用头自适应稀疏预算，无需重训即可显著提升扩散大语言模型的推理速度。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型在每个去噪步骤中重算完整注意力图导致二次方计算开销。现有稀疏注意力方法采用统一稀疏预算且在初始预热后复用固定掩码，忽视了注意力模式在不同步骤的局部一致性与突变特性，以及不同注意力头之间集中度的差异。
AI.method: 提出Step-dLLM，沿去噪轨迹在锚点步骤周期性刷新块稀疏掩码并在局部一致区间内复用；同时采用头自适应全局预算，对注意力集中的头部进行更激进的压缩；并利用融合IO感知的Triton内核实现块稀疏注意力，无需重训直接应用于预训练模型。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-1.5上（8K上下文、256去噪步、90%稀疏度）实现了比密集FlashAttention端到端2.78倍的加速，并在准确率-延迟权衡上优于现有的稀疏注意力方法。
AI.conclusion: Step-dLLM通过动态适应扩散模型注意力随步骤变化及各头部差异的结构特性，有效降低了单步计算成本，在不牺牲准确率的情况下显著提升了推理效率。

title: KV Cache Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
summary: KV cache quantization is well studied for autoregressive language models, where cached prefix states are exact under causal attention and quantization is mainly a cache reconstruction problem. Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break this assumption. Fast dLLM inference reuses KV states across denoising steps, but bidirectional token representations can change as masked tokens are revealed, so the reused cache may already differ from full recomputation before quantization is applied. We study KV cache quantization under this cache-reuse error. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to Fast-dLLM-style prefix and dual cache reuse, and introduce TRACE and dLLM-KVQ. TRACE reconstructs feasible dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs, providing calibration states that match iterative masked decoding. dLLM-KVQ uses these trajectories to choose per-layer K-cache entries that remain in high precision according to output- and attention-level behavior metrics, while applying standard low-bit value quantization. Across LLaDA and Dream evaluations on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and MBPP, dLLM-KVQ achieves the highest average score among quantized methods across the reported 4-bit and 2-bit prefix/dual cache settings.

AI.tldr: 本文针对扩散语言模型（dLLM）在KV缓存重用误差下的量化问题，提出了TRACE轨迹重建与dLLM-KVQ混合精度量化方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在推理重用KV状态时，因双向表征随掩码揭示而改变，会产生缓存重用误差，打破了自回归模型中缓存精确的假设，使得现有针对自回归模型的KV缓存量化方法不再适用。
AI.method: 将KIVI和KVQuant适配至Fast-dLLM式的缓存重用机制；提出TRACE重建揭示轨迹以提供匹配的校准状态；提出dLLM-KVQ，利用该轨迹根据输出与注意力指标逐层选择保留高精度的K缓存项，并对其他部分应用标准低比特值量化。
AI.result: 在LLaDA和Dream模型上的GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH和MBPP评测中，dLLM-KVQ在4-bit和2-bit的前缀/双缓存设置下取得了所有量化方法中的最高平均得分。
AI.conclusion: dLLM-KVQ有效解决了dLLM中的缓存重用误差与量化问题，在极低比特量化下仍保持优异性能，为扩散语言模型的高效推理提供了可靠的量化方案。

title: DWISE: Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine
summary: Unlike autoregressive large language models (AR-LLMs), diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising many tokens in parallel, offering a promising path to efficient inference. Existing serving frameworks, however, schedule dLLM requests with policies designed for AR models, namely first-come-first-served (FCFS) admission and prefill priority. We find that both policies are ill-suited to dLLMs, wasting much of their speed. FCFS ignores that a dLLM request's decoding cost is highly heterogeneous and unknown at arrival, causing severe head-of-line blocking. Prefill priority, widely used in AR-LLM serving to keep time-to-first-token low, sharply cuts dLLM efficiency, as rounds that run only prompts leave most of the batch idle. We present DWISE, a Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine for efficient dLLM serving. DWISE schedules requests by their remaining work, measured in a block-level unit shared by prefill and denoising, so both phases share a round. To predict the unknown denoising workload, DWISE combines a lightweight prompt-based predictor at admission with a single refinement from the first denoising round's hidden states, which capture model-specific information absent from the prompt and require no additional model execution. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on five models from three dLLM families under bursty workloads, DWISE reduces mean end-to-end latency over SGLang by 5.4$\times$ on average and up to 14.9$\times$ while preserving task accuracy. The code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出DWISE调度引擎，通过预测去噪工作量并合并预填充与去噪轮次，大幅提升扩散语言模型的推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有服务系统采用为自回归模型设计的调度策略服务dLLMs，忽略了dLLM解码成本的异质性且与预填充优先级不兼容，导致严重的队头阻塞和批次空闲，浪费了推理速度。
AI.method: 提出DWISE，基于共享的块级剩余工作量单位调度请求以合并预填充和去噪阶段；利用轻量级提示词预测器结合首轮去噪隐藏状态的细化来预测未知去噪工作量。
AI.result: 在SGLang上跨三个dLLM家族五个模型进行评估，相比基线SGLang，平均端到端延迟降低5.4倍，最高达14.9倍，且不损失准确率。
AI.conclusion: DWISE有效提升了突发负载下dLLM的推理效率，验证了去噪工作量感知调度的必要性。

title: Cord: Confidence-Anchored Order Residual Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: The decoding order of masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can substantially affect generation quality, yet common decoders typically apply the same reveal rule throughout generation. Confidence provides a strong default, but it measures how decisively a position can be predicted now, not how useful revealing that position will be for subsequent decoding. We propose Cord, a lightweight prompt-conditioned policy that retains confidence decoding as a stable reference and learns when and how to depart from it through geometric residuals over generation direction, proximity to revealed context, and two-sided infilling. The residuals adapt to both the prompt and the evolving partial response. Rather than sampling a new policy action at every decoding step, Cord samples a single low-dimensional coefficient matrix per rollout, which induces an entire state-dependent reveal trajectory. This yields a contextual-bandit formulation trained directly from sequence-level rewards, without step-level credit assignment or backbone updates. Across three dLLMs and five reasoning, code, and constraint-satisfaction benchmarks, Cord improves average task success from 32.0% under confidence decoding to 48.2%, and further improves over the best per-domain fixed residual. Behavioral audits show that the learned residuals induce substantial, task-dependent changes in reveal locality and two-sided infilling. Cord adds only $0.53$M trainable parameters, requires no additional backbone forward passes, and incurs only 5.39% inference latency overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cord，一种轻量级的提示条件解码策略，通过学习何时偏离置信度解码来提升掩码扩散语言模型的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型的解码顺序显著影响生成质量，但常见解码器在整个生成过程中采用固定的揭示规则。置信度虽为强默认策略，但仅衡量当前位置当前的可预测性，而非揭示该位置对后续解码的有用性。
AI.method: Cord以置信度解码为稳定参考，通过生成方向、已揭示上下文的邻近度及双侧填充的几何残差学习何时偏离。每次rollout仅采样一个低维系数矩阵，生成完整的状态依赖揭示轨迹，采用上下文老虎机框架从序列级奖励直接训练，无需步级信用分配或骨干网络更新。
AI.result: 在三个dLLM和五个推理、代码、约束满足基准上，Cord将平均任务成功率从置信度解码的32.0%提升至48.2%，并优于最佳逐域固定残差。仅增加0.53M可训练参数，推理延迟开销仅5.39%，无需额外骨干网络前向传播。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的残差诱导了显著的、任务依赖的揭示局部性和双侧填充行为变化，证明解码顺序策略的动态调整对dLLM生成质量至关重要。Cord以极低开销实现了有效的序列级解码策略优化。

title: DForkTree: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Fork-Aware Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up language models by having a lightweight drafter propose future tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash predict an entire block in one forward pass, and DDTree builds draft trees directly from their per-position distributions. Each distribution implicitly assumes that the drafter's own greedy continuation is accepted, whereas a draft tree improves over a chain only on branches that leave this greedy path. Once a path forks, the drafter's top-1 accuracy drops from 89% to 18% and its top candidates often miss the true token. Re-running the drafter from the fork token largely restores its accuracy, showing that the errors stem from conditioning on an outdated prefix rather than from limited model capacity. In this paper, we introduce DForkTree, a training-free method that re-anchors each branch on its own tokens. It adjusts the drafter's scores with pointwise mutual information from target-generated n-grams, weighted more heavily after a fork, and a layer-wise GPU search recovers the exact optimal tree under these scores. On Qwen3.5-4B and 9B, DForkTree outperforms all baselines on every benchmark, by up to 41.5% over DFlash and 15.1% over DDTree, with average speedups of up to 4.75x over autoregressive decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DForkTree，一种无需训练的推测解码方法，通过在分支处重新锚定草稿模型的条件前缀并利用逐点互信息调整得分，显著提升了块扩散草稿树的接受率和解码速度。
AI.motivation: 块扩散草稿器（如DFlash）构建的草稿树在路径分叉后，由于仍基于过时的贪婪前缀进行预测，其top-1准确率从89%骤降至18%，导致候选token频繁出错，严重制约了推测解码的加速效果。
AI.method: DForkTree在分支处用该分支自身的token重新锚定草稿器条件前缀；利用目标模型生成的n-gram的逐点互信息（PMI）调整草稿器得分，分叉后权重更强；并采用逐层GPU搜索在修正得分下恢复精确最优草稿树。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B和9B模型上，DForkTree在所有基准测试中均优于全部基线方法，相比DFlash提升最高41.5%，相比DDTree提升最高15.1%，平均加速比最高达4.75倍（相对于自回归解码）。
AI.conclusion: 分叉后草稿器准确率下降的根因是条件前缀过时而非模型容量不足；通过对每个分支重新锚定并引入PMI修正得分，可大幅提升草稿树质量和解码速度，且方法无需额外训练即插即用。

title: Multi-Future Drafting: Mixture Block Drafters for Tree-Verified Speculative Decoding
summary: Block drafters such as DFlash draft a block of future tokens in one forward pass, and draft trees such as DDTree verify the prefixes ranked highest by the product of the drafter's per-position distributions. Under tree verification, the expected number of accepted tokens is the probability mass the tree covers. We show that a product misallocates it: when the continuation can follow several futures, it splices them into chimeras, prefixes stitched together from different futures that the target never produces, and gives them as much budget as the futures themselves. Barring ties, no product-ranked tree can hold two futures that disagree in $m$ positions without $2^{m-1}-1$ chimeras, however well the drafter is trained, and in practice chimeras make up 27-33% of a 64-node tree. We propose Multi-Future Drafting (MFD), which restores the coupling with a latent variable instead of the chain rule: $K$ learned mode embeddings at the drafter's input draft $K$ coherent blocks in the same pass, and a mixture DDTree lets the verifier pick the future the target takes, losslessly and with $K+1$ extra vectors. On four Qwen targets from 4B to 27B parameters, at batch size 1, MFD reaches up to 7.8$\times$ speedup, 5-8% faster than the best single-mode tree trained identically and, on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, 9-16% faster than the released DARTree trained on the same prompts.

AI.tldr: 提出多未来起草（MFD）方法，利用潜在变量替代链式法则解决树验证中的“嵌合体”问题，显著提升大语言模型推理加速比。
AI.motivation: 传统乘积排序的树验证方法会将不同未来序列拼接为模型不生成的“嵌合体”前缀，浪费概率质量预算并降低接受率。
AI.method: 在草稿模型输入端引入K个可学习模式嵌入以一次性生成K个连贯块，并使用混合DDTree使验证器无损地选择正确未来。
AI.result: 在Qwen 4B-27B模型上批大小为1时，达到最高7.8倍加速，较最优单模态树快5-8%，在Qwen3-4B/8B上较DARTree快9-16%。
AI.conclusion: MFD通过解耦多未来生成与验证，在无精度损失的前提下有效提升了推理速度。

title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出树退出验证（TEV）和退出引导草稿树训练（ExitTrain），通过目标流视角优化树式推测解码的验证与树结构。
AI.motivation: 树式推测解码中基于草稿得分构建的有限树存在草稿-目标不匹配的根本问题，需要提升固定树上的接受率并利用目标反馈改进树结构。
AI.method: 通过目标流视角推导出规范退出定律，证明目标覆盖率严格界定任意精确路径验证器的期望输出块长度；提出TEV（一种精确的层级并行验证过程，仅需一次退出节点决策和一次奖励令牌决策）和ExitTrain（利用缺失目标概率作为节点级反馈训练推理时草稿树）。
AI.result: 实验在对话、代码和数学推理任务上验证：ExitTrain使平均输出块长度增加13%，TEV使验证器阶段延迟降低15%，端到端速度相比DDTree提升14%。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了两类优化机会：构建更优草稿树以提高接受率，以及采用更直接的验证方式以降低延迟，两者可协同提升推测解码效率。

title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model inference: a small drafter proposes several tokens, and the target model verifies them in one parallel pass. Drafting a tree lets the target verify many alternative continuations at once. DDTree builds such trees from the block-diffusion drafter DFlash, but scores each position independently of the tokens earlier in its branch; Domino conditions on those tokens but drafts only a single chain. DominoTree combines the two: a training-free best-first tree scored by Domino's path-dependent causal correction, restricted to top-M candidates. In a research harness at temperature zero, it averages 5.33x speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding on Qwen3-4B and 6.89x on Qwen3-8B, peaking at 8.77x; across temperatures it is 20-26% faster than Domino on Qwen3-4B and 27-36% on Qwen3-8B, and 11-20% faster than the stronger of DDTree and its cost-aware variant CaDDTree. A controlled decomposition attributes +10.1% (Qwen3-4B) and +10.7% (Qwen3-8B) accepted length to the correction, and +4.7% and +4.4% to conditioning on the realized path. Served in SGLang on one RTX 5090, it reaches 4.11x and 4.83x AR at batch size 1, 1.17x and 1.09x the speed of Domino's chain, and up to 1.71x AR on 8K-token HELMET summarization, 14-21% above the chain. The lead holds at 2 concurrent requests but reverses from 8 onward, where the chain sustains more goodput despite DominoTree's 28% higher acceptance. DominoTree accepts more tokens than the chain in every serving setting. On the hybrid Gated-DeltaNet Qwen3.6-27B, correct output requires tree-aware recurrent verification; with it, DominoTree matches the chain at batch size 1 (4.58x versus 4.54x AR) and reaches up to 2.11x AR at long context, 15% above the chain.
comment: 31 pages. Submitted to IEEE Access. v4: adds Qwen3.6-27B results, single-GPU serving re-runs, fused tree-builder kernels and tuned budgets; code and data at https://github.com/slin-zhq/Domino-Tree

AI.tldr: DominoTree结合树形草稿与路径相关因果校正评分,在大语言模型推理中实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: DDTree独立评分各位置而忽略分支前缀token,Domino虽依赖路径条件但仅生成单链;二者各有局限,需同时获得树形并行验证与路径相关评分的优势。
AI.method: 采用免训练的best-first树结构(限制top-M候选),使用Domino的路径相关因果校正进行评分,将树形草稿与条件化评分相结合。
AI.result: 温度零下Qwen3-4B/8B平均加速5.33x/6.89x(峰值8.77x);比Domino快20-36%,比DDTree快11-20%。SGLang单卡RTX5090上batch1达4.11x/4.83x;8K上下文总结达1.71x。接受长度提升中+10.1%/+10.7%来自校正,+4.7%/+4.4%来自路径条件化。高并发(≥8)时链式吞吐更高,但DominoTree接受token数始终更多。
AI.conclusion: 路径相关校正与树形结构互补结合优于任一单独方案;混合架构(如Gated-DeltaNet)需tree-aware recurrent verification保证正确性;在低并发和长上下文场景优势明显,高并发下链式仍具吞吐优势。

title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding raises the mean accepted tokens of standard speculative decoding by verifying multiple draft paths, and existing tree builders typically construct these paths through parent-conditioned expansion, where each child token is generated conditioned on its parent path. This construction is incompatible with diffusion language model (DLM) drafters such as DFlash, which produces all future-position distributions in a single forward pass. DDTree bridges this gap by treating high-probability tokens from each future-position distribution as candidate nodes and selecting edges between consecutive positions under a fixed node budget. However, its edge selection relies on token probability alone without modeling parent--child compatibility, so target-compatible tokens can be attached to wrong parents; moreover, its fixed budget ignores that the throughput-optimal tree size varies with the decoding state. We propose GRAFT, a draft-tree construction framework for DLM-based speculative decoding. GRAFT introduces Target-Distilled Edge Scoring (TDES), which distills parent--child preferences from target-model traces to select target-compatible edges, and State-Aware Budget Allocation (SABA), which sets the per-round tree budget by balancing expected draft gain against verification cost. Across multiple models and tasks, GRAFT achieves $2.13\times$--$6.36\times$ end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding while adding less than $0.5$\,ms of overhead per round, approximately $1.4\%$ of the target-model verification latency.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAFT框架，通过目标蒸馏边缘评分和状态感知预算分配来解决扩散语言模型在树状推测解码中的树构建问题。
AI.motivation: 现有树状推测解码的父节点条件扩展不适用于扩散语言模型（DLM）草稿器，而现有的DDTree方法仅依赖概率选择边缘且预算固定，存在父子节点兼容性差及未考虑解码状态动态变化的问题。
AI.method: 提出GRAFT框架，包含目标蒸馏边缘评分（TDES）和状态感知预算分配（SABA）。TDES从目标模型轨迹中蒸馏父子偏好以选择兼容边缘，SABA通过平衡预期草稿增益与验证成本来动态设置每轮树预算。
AI.result: 在多个模型和任务上，GRAFT相比自回归解码实现了2.13倍至6.36倍的端到端加速，且每轮额外开销不到0.5毫秒（约占目标模型验证延迟的1.4%）。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT通过引入目标兼容的边缘评分和自适应预算分配，有效解决了DLM草稿器在树状推测解码中的应用瓶颈，实现了显著的推理加速且开销极低。

title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens verified in parallel by the target language model. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate an entire draft block in one pass, yielding per-position marginals; DDTree uses these to build a candidate tree that maximizes expected acceptance length under a fixed node budget. We observe, however, that acceptance length is non-decreasing in budget: it always favors larger trees regardless of verification cost, offering no principled basis for budget selection. We introduce \textbf{CaDDTree} (Cost-aware Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that directly optimizes token throughput (expected tokens generated per unit time) by jointly selecting the tree structure and node budget. We model draft and verification latencies explicitly, show that the throughput objective decomposes into a per-round one-dimensional search over the budget, and prove that under a convex verification cost the throughput function is \emph{unimodal}, enabling an efficient greedy stopping rule. CaDDTree requires no offline budget search, adapting the budget each round from the current per-position distributions and verification cost. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction-following tasks show that \caDDTree{} matches or surpasses DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出CaDDTree方法，通过显式建模草稿和验证延迟，联合优化树结构和节点预算，直接最大化token吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有DDTree方法以接受长度为目标，该指标随预算单调递增，倾向于选择更大的树而忽视验证成本，缺乏选择节点预算的原则性依据。
AI.method: CaDDTree将token吞吐量（每单位时间生成token数）作为直接优化目标，显式建模草稿与验证延迟，将吞吐量目标分解为每轮对预算的一维搜索，并在凸验证成本下证明吞吐量函数具有单峰性，从而使用贪心停止规则高效求解；每轮根据当前位置分布和验证成本自适应调整预算，无需离线预算搜索。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B模型上、覆盖推理、编程和指令遵循的八个基准测试中，CaDDTree在几乎所有任务上匹配或超越使用Oracle预算选择的DDTree。
AI.conclusion: CaDDTree通过将验证成本纳入树构建的优化目标，消除了预算选择的启发式依赖，在不牺牲性能的前提下实现了自适应的每轮预算调整，为块扩散推测解码提供了更优的树构建范式。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAPS方法，通过目标感知的前缀选择优化基于扩散模型的投机解码验证过程，显著提升无损推理速度。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型用于并行起草虽降低了起草延迟，但将瓶颈转移至验证阶段。现有方法基于边缘概率排序节点，忽略了验证的前缀条件性，导致验证被拒前缀的不可达后代，增加延迟且收益有限。
AI.method: 提出TAPS（目标感知前缀选择），将扩散模型的边缘概率转化为路径条件的接受概率估计，并在固定验证预算下选择紧凑的前缀闭合子树，优化接受度与成本权衡。
AI.result: 实验显示，TAPS相比传统自回归解码实现高达7.9倍的无损端到端加速，并分别比最先进的DFlash和DDTree快1.36倍和1.74倍。
AI.conclusion: TAPS有效解决了现有扩散树方法中的验证瓶颈，在固定预算下最大化接受长度，为LLM推理加速提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: DDTree通过从块扩散草稿模型的逐位置分布构建草稿树，在单次前向传播中验证多个候选轨迹，提升了推测解码的接受长度和性能。
AI.motivation: DFlash虽然性能领先，但每轮仅验证单条草稿轨迹，限制了接受长度，从而制约了推测解码的加速潜力。
AI.method: DDTree利用块扩散草稿模型的逐位置分布，通过基于堆的best-first算法在固定节点预算下选择最可能匹配目标模型的续写路径，构建草稿树，并使用ancestor-only attention mask在目标模型单次前向传播中高效验证。
AI.result: DDTree在DFlash基础上进一步提升了推测解码性能，跻身当前领先的推测解码方法之列。
AI.conclusion: DDTree有效突破了单轨迹验证的瓶颈，证明了从块扩散模型分布构建草稿树的可行性和优越性，为推测解码提供了新的改进方向。

title: VIVID: Beyond Static Multi-Image Reasoning with Localized Visual Differences and Textual Entity Dynamics in Video MLLMs
summary: Video question answering under tight frame budgets requires preserving localized motion and event order, yet current video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reduce comprehension to static multi-image reasoning by discarding unselected frames and encoding keyframes independently: (1) Spatially, whole-frame pooling dilutes small moving targets into static backgrounds; (2) Temporally, dropping intermediate frames or averaging tokens erases inter-frame motion, confusing direction, speed, and order. We propose VIVID (Visual Inter-frame Variations and Individual Dynamics), which moves beyond static snapshots like human vision: keyframes capture core states while inter-frame Patch Diffs preserve neighboring changes within $K_f$ keyframes. Autonomous Delta-Driven Keyframe Planning (ADKP) selects anchors from a $3\text{ fps}$ pool and feeds surrounding patch differences into Dual-Road Change Memory (DRCM), forming Dynamic Tokens at zero extra anchor tokens alongside a camera-stabilized Active Motion Region of Interest (ROI) and chronological Entity State Chains. Adding $0.22\%$ trainable parameters to a frozen $27\text{B}$ backbone, VIVID-Small ($50$ examples, $\sim 1.5$ GPU hours) beats all eleven baselines in overall accuracy across $8,083$ questions and trails only VIVID-Large ($3,600$ examples), which leads on MotionBench, Video-MME, and TempCompass.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIVID模型，通过捕获帧间变化和个体动态，在极低帧预算和极少参数下显著提升了视频问答的准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前视频多模态大语言模型在有限帧预算下将视频理解降级为静态多图推理，丢弃中间帧或独立编码关键帧导致局部运动被背景稀释，且帧间运动信息丢失，造成方向、速度和顺序混乱。
AI.method: 提出VIVID模型，利用自主增量驱动关键帧规划（ADKP）选择锚点，将帧间Patch差异输入双路变化记忆（DRCM）形成动态Token，并结合相机稳定的主动运动ROI和按时间顺序的实体状态链来保留运动细节。
AI.result: 在27B冻结主干上仅添加0.22%可训练参数，VIVID-Small（50个样本）在8083个问题中超越所有11个基线；VIVID-Large（3600个样本）在MotionBench、Video-MME和TempCompass上均取得领先。
AI.conclusion: VIVID通过显式建模帧间视觉变化和个体动态，以极低的计算和参数成本解决了视频问答中的静态推理瓶颈，实现了高效且先进的性能。

title: Stress Testing a Multimodal Large Language Model Grading Assistant on Kinematics Graph Reading
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can recognize graph features yet award credit without sufficient graphical support. This exploratory study examines selected grading outputs for synthetic responses to four kinematics exercises, generated through visual distortion and progressive transformation toward reference graphs. Different model and prompt configurations were used. Some judgments correctly distinguished instantaneous zero velocity from rest over a finite interval and recognized positive curvature. Yet a severely distorted velocity--time graph received full credit despite disconnected and branching traces and an unclear zero-velocity reference. Other submissions graded under the same configuration lost substantial credit. Numerical cutoffs intended to distinguish meaningful features from drawing irregularities were supplied without a coordinate convention for unnumbered graphs, leaving the basis of exact partial-credit awards unresolved. Stress testing can expose unsupported awards before classroom use. For the configurations examined, we do not recommend accepting scores as final grades without instructor review, including review of full-credit responses.

AI.tldr: 多模态大语言模型在批改运动学图表题时可能给出缺乏图形依据的分数，因此不建议将其得分直接作为最终成绩。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在批改运动学图像题时缺乏充分图形依据就给予评分的现象，以保障自动评分的可靠性。
AI.method: 通过视觉失真和逐渐趋近参考图的方式生成合成运动学图像作答，采用不同的模型与提示配置，分析模型对这些合成作答的评分输出。
AI.result: 模型能正确区分瞬时零速度与有限区间静止并识别正曲率；但对严重失真、轨迹断裂的图像仍给满分，同配置下的其他作答却失分严重；对无坐标刻度图像依据数值截断给分导致部分给分依据不明确。
AI.conclusion: 压力测试可在课堂使用前暴露无依据给分；不建议将所测配置的得分作为最终成绩，必须经过教师人工审查，包括对满分作答的审查。

title: FVScore: Specification-Driven Neuro-Symbolic Video Evaluation
summary: We introduce Faithfulness Video Score (FVSCORE), a neuro-symbolic framework for specification-driven video generation evaluation. Existing evaluators rely on holistic MLLM judgments or vision-language metrics, yet aligning their scores with human judgments and tracing them to specific temporal violations remain open challenges. FVSCORE addresses these limitations by compiling each video into explicit propositions capturing prompt requirements and implicit propositions capturing unstated physical, temporal, and cross-modal constraints. It grounds each proposition using specialized perceptual tools and evaluates the resulting confidence traces with soft temporal operators inspired by Linear Temporal Logic. A Significance-Aware Calibration step then aligns verification with human perception by retaining only perceptually significant violations before producing a timestamp- and evidence-grounded report. We conduct extensive experiments across public and complex multi-event benchmarks with the strongest video models to date, demonstrating that FVSCORE outperforms holistic and agent-based evaluators in human correlation while providing highly accurate and interpretable feedback.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了FVSCORE，一个用于视频生成评估的神经符号框架，通过对时间约束进行显式和隐式命题的编译与验证，提供高度可解释且与人类判断高度相关的反馈。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频生成评估器在实现分数与人类判断对齐，以及将分数追踪到特定时间违规方面仍面临挑战。
AI.method: FVSCORE将视频编译为捕捉提示词要求的显式命题和捕捉未明说物理等约束的隐式命题；利用专用感知工具对其进行基础化；使用受线性时序逻辑启发的软时间算子评估置信度轨迹；最后通过显著性感知校准保留感知上有意义的违规，生成报告。
AI.result: 在公共和复杂多事件基准上的广泛实验表明，FVSCORE在人类相关性方面优于整体和基于代理的评估器，同时提供了高度准确和可解释的反馈。
AI.conclusion: FVSCORE有效解决了视频生成评估中与人类判断对齐和违规可追溯性的问题，为该领域提供了更可靠和可解释的评估方向。

title: SpatialCast: Reading the 3D World via Cast Shadows
summary: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance toward understanding and interacting with the physical world, spatial reasoning becomes essential for understanding scene structure and anticipating the effects of physical changes. Existing spatial benchmarks have made substantial progress in evaluating spatial relations, memory, and viewpoint reasoning, but less systematically assess how models connect physical scene conditions with visual observations. We introduce SpatialCast, a benchmark that uses cast shadows to evaluate this ability. Cast shadows provide observable evidence of a 3D scene. Their image appearance depends on object geometry and pose, illumination, and viewpoint. We examine this relationship through three complementary tasks that assess scene-projection consistency, predict intervention-induced changes, and infer the physical changes behind visual transitions. The benchmark contains 21,000 synthetic questions with separate scene and geometry test partitions, complemented by 200 SpatialCast-Real questions from 20 photographed scenes. Evaluations show that closed-source MLLMs outperform general-purpose open-weight MLLMs and MLLMs designed for spatial reasoning, which remain near chance on the synthetic benchmark, while even strong closed-source models struggle with shadow-length and light-height judgments. We also use SpatialCast training data for GRPO post-training, improving open-weight MLLM performance on the benchmark. Further evaluations show improvements on several external spatial benchmarks, suggesting transfer of the learned capabilities. These experiments support SpatialCast as a controlled resource for diagnosing spatial reasoning capabilities and studying their learning and generalization.
comment: 10 pages (main paper), 7 pages (supplementary material), 5 figures and 6 tables in the main paper

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SpatialCast基准，通过投射阴影任务评估多模态大语言模型将物理场景条件与视觉观察相联系的空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理基准较少系统评估模型如何将物理场景条件与视觉观察联系起来，缺乏对模型理解场景结构与物理变化预见能力的诊断工具。
AI.method: 构建包含21,000个合成问题和200个真实场景问题的SpatialCast基准，通过场景投影一致性、预测干预引起的变化、推断视觉转换背后的物理变化三项互补任务，基于投射阴影评估模型能力；并使用GRPO后训练方法改进开权重模型性能。
AI.result: 闭源MLLM优于通用开源和专门设计用于空间推理的MLLM（后者在合成基准上接近随机水平）；即使是强闭源模型在阴影长度和光照高度判断上仍有困难；GRPO后训练提升了开源模型在SpatialCast及多个外部空间基准上的表现，显示出能力迁移。
AI.conclusion: SpatialCast可作为诊断空间推理能力的受控资源，用于研究其学习与泛化规律；未来可进一步探索如何提升模型在复杂物理推理任务上的表现。

title: OmniTongue: A Comprehensive MLLM Benchmark for Automated Tongue Diagnosis in Traditional Chinese Medicine
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have excelled in Western medical imaging, yet their potential in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) tongue diagnosis remains systematically unevaluated. Tongue diagnosis requires sophisticated global and local perception, serving as a rigorous touchstone for assessing the visual understanding depth of MLLMs. However, existing datasets are limited by single dimensions, coarse granularity, and ambiguous labels, hindering the evaluation of authentic clinical capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniTongue, the first comprehensive, fine-grained Visual Question Answering benchmark for TCM tongue diagnosis. This benchmark integrates 1,351 expert-validated images and 21,616 instruction pairs. Its core design features 16 clinical dimensions for multidimensional evaluation, region-specific annotations for pathological localization, and 66 fine-grained labels for precise diagnostic representation. Extensive evaluations of existing MLLMs reveal significant performance gaps, demonstrating that medical-specific models lack domain advantages, while universally poor Macro-F1 scores expose a reliance on statistical shortcuts rather than genuine understanding of tongue pathology. These findings not only highlight the current limitations of MLLMs in interpreting regional medical features but also underscore OmniTongue's significance for developing robust automated tongue diagnosis models. The code and dataset will be made publicly available in a future release.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OmniTongue，首个用于中医舌诊的综合细粒度视觉问答基准，揭示了现有多模态大语言模型在舌部病理理解方面的显著局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在中医舌诊领域的潜力尚未被系统评估，且现有数据集存在维度单一、粒度粗糙、标签模糊等问题，无法真实评估模型的临床诊断能力，因此亟需构建一个全面、细粒度的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建了OmniTongue基准，包含1,351张经专家验证的舌象图像和21,616个指令对，核心设计涵盖16个临床维度的多维评估、区域特异性标注以实现病理定位、以及66个细粒度标签以精确表达诊断信息。
AI.result: 对现有MLLMs的广泛评测显示显著的性能差距，医学专用模型并未展现领域优势，普遍偏低的Macro-F1分数表明模型依赖统计捷径而非对舌部病理的真正理解。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前MLLMs在解读区域医学特征方面的局限性，凸显了OmniTongue对开发鲁棒的自动化舌诊模型的重要意义，代码和数据集将于后续公开发布。

title: Semantic-Guided Geometric Decoding for Token-Efficient Visual Grounding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a unified interface for language-conditioned visual perception. In pixel-to-sequence grounding, autoregressive coordinate generation requires multiple sequential decoding steps per box, increasing inference cost with the number of instances. Pixel-to-embedding methods reduce this overhead but lack explicit spatial encoding when using a shared special token. We introduce SemGeo, a token-efficient visual grounding framework that represents each instance with a single grid token for coarse localization. A geometric decoder reuses visual features and hidden states to recover precise discrete box coordinates in parallel. To train proposal generation and box localization together, we introduce Gaussian soft labels that encode coordinate distances during supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Reinforcement post-training further combines box-set rewards with coordinate supervision on model-generated proposals. This stage trains the language model and geometric decoder on their own predictions to mitigate the mismatch between teacher-forced training and inference. Across eight benchmarks spanning object detection, referring object detection, and document layout grounding, SemGeo achieves the highest F1@mIou among compared MLLMs on six benchmarks. It also delivers $2.07\times$ and $1.25\times$ the mean box-generation throughput of representative grounding baselines under vLLM and Transformers, respectively, while achieving higher accuracy in both comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SemGeo，一种高效的视觉定位框架，通过单个网格标记和并行几何解码器恢复坐标，在保持高精度的同时显著提升了吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决多模态大语言模型在视觉定位中自回归坐标生成导致推理成本随实例数增加，以及像素到嵌入方法缺乏显式空间编码的问题。
AI.method: 提出SemGeo框架，使用单个网格标记进行粗定位，并利用几何解码器并行恢复精确坐标；在监督微调阶段引入高斯软标签，在强化后训练阶段结合边界框集合奖励与坐标监督以缓解训练与推理的不匹配。
AI.result: 在八个基准测试中的六个取得了最高F1@mIou；在vLLM和Transformers框架下分别实现了2.07倍和1.25倍的边界框生成平均吞吐量，且准确率更高。
AI.conclusion: SemGeo成功在视觉定位的准确率和推理效率之间取得了优异平衡，为多模态大语言模型的高效定位提供了有效方案。

title: From Perception to Simulation: Unveiling and Empowering Mental Spatial Dynamics in MLLMs
summary: Spatial reasoning is a fundamental component of world understanding for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While existing research has advanced the perception of spatial relations in static scenes, the domain of dynamic spatial simulation remains relatively unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce MentalGrid, a benchmark focused on spatial reasoning tasks that require models to simulate evolving spatial states without intermediate visual feedback. Extensive evaluation on our benchmark reveals a significant deficiency in the spatial simulation capabilities of existing models. Specifically, we find that performance is constrained by perceptual limitations in simple simulation scenarios and hindered by inadequate multi-step reasoning as complexity increases. To address these challenges, we propose a three-stage curriculum learning framework utilizing 16k specialized spatial reasoning samples. This approach yields SpatialWalker, which achieves a 33.8% average improvement over its base model, surpassing proprietary models like Gemini-3-Flash in spatial simulation. Furthermore, SpatialWalker demonstrates robust generalization, maintaining a 4.9% average gain on out-of-domain benchmarks, demonstrating the pivotal role of spatial simulation as a fundamental building block for broader spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MentalGrid基准和三阶段课程学习框架，以提升多模态大语言模型的动态空间模拟能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态大语言模型在静态场景的空间感知方面取得进展，但无需中间视觉反馈的动态空间模拟仍未被充分探索，且现有模型在此方面存在感知局限和多步推理不足的问题。
AI.method: 引入MentalGrid基准以评估动态空间模拟，并提出利用1.6万个专用样本的三阶段课程学习框架训练出SpatialWalker模型。
AI.result: SpatialWalker较基础模型平均提升33.8%，在空间模拟上超越Gemini-3-Flash等专有模型，并在域外基准测试中保持4.9%的平均提升。
AI.conclusion: 空间模拟是更广泛空间智能的关键基础模块，对提升模型的空间推理与泛化能力具有重要意义。

title: SpatialMind: Adaptive Multi-Level Geometric Fusion for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate promising capabilities in 2D visual understanding, yet remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Recent studies explore integrating 3D reconstruction models into MLLMs. However, these approaches either use a single geometric granularity across all tasks or adopt a fixed multi-level fusion scheme, regardless of task-specific reasoning requirements. Through systematic experiments on multi-level geometric fusion, we find that spatial tasks at different cognitive levels (e.g., distance estimation vs. route planning) require geometric representations of different granularities, revealing that fixed fusion cannot accommodate diverse spatial reasoning requirements. To bridge this gap, we propose SpatialMind, a task-adaptive framework for dynamically integrating multi-level geometric representations. SpatialMind employs GeoFus, a multi-layer geometric fusion module built around a gating network jointly conditioned on textual instructions, visual semantics, and geometric representations. This network adaptively modulates the contributions of shallow, intermediate, and deep geometric features across the layers of the LLM decoder. Furthermore, we introduce a negative-entropy regularization loss to mitigate gate collapse. Gate visualizations indicate that GeoFus adapts geometric granularity to task requirements. Experiments demonstrate that SpatialMind achieves competitive performance across spatial benchmarks, attaining a state-of-the-art score of 72.3 on VSI-Bench. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/zhaosb-star/SpatialMind.
comment: Includes supplementary material. Code available at https://github.com/zhaosb-star/SpatialMind

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SpatialMind框架，通过动态融合多层级几何表征来提升多模态大语言模型在3D空间推理任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在3D空间推理方面能力有限，而现有的3D几何融合方法采用固定的单一粒度或固定多层级融合方案，无法满足不同认知层次空间任务（如距离估计与路径规划）对几何表征粒度的差异化需求。
AI.method: 提出SpatialMind框架，其核心为GeoFus多层级几何融合模块，通过一个联合受文本指令、视觉语义和几何表征条件驱动的门控网络，自适应调节浅层、中间层和深层几何特征在LLM解码器各层的贡献；并引入负熵正则化损失以缓解门控坍缩问题。
AI.result: 门控可视化表明GeoFus能根据任务需求自适应调整几何粒度；在多个空间基准测试中取得竞争性表现，并在VSI-Bench上达到72.3的当前最优分数。
AI.conclusion: 不同空间推理任务确实需要不同粒度的几何表征，固定融合策略无法适应这种多样性；通过任务自适应的动态几何融合机制可有效提升MLLM的空间推理能力，代码已开源以促进后续研究。

title: Can Vision-Language Models Truly Understand Images? A Benchmark Beyond Commonsense Bias
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance on a wide range of vision-language tasks. However, it remains unclear whether their predictions are grounded in the visual content itself or are largely driven by statistical co-occurrence patterns and commonsense correlations learned from large-scale image-text corpora. Existing vision-language benchmarks predominantly consist of samples that conform to human commonsense, allowing models to achieve strong performance by exploiting dataset priors rather than genuinely understanding image content. To address this limitation, we present ContraSense, a systematically constructed benchmark for evaluating faithful vision-language understanding. ContraSense consists of carefully curated counter-intuitive image-text pairs that deliberately violate common expectations, substantially reducing the effectiveness of statistical biases and requiring models to rely on visual evidence for reasoning. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on a diverse set of representative open- and closed-source MLLMs. The results reveal a substantial performance gap between current MLLMs and humans: even the strongest closed-source model achieves only about 60\% accuracy, compared with 96.04\% for human participants. These findings demonstrate that current MLLMs still struggle with faithful visual understanding and highlight the need for more robust multimodal reasoning grounded in image content. The ContraSense benchmark is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/LingLin00/ContraSense.

AI.tldr: ContraSense基准通过反直觉图文对评估多模态大模型的真实视觉理解能力，揭示了它们与人类之间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言基准多符合人类常识，使得模型可通过利用数据集先验而非真正理解图像内容来获得高分，无法确定模型预测是否真正基于视觉内容。
AI.method: 提出ContraSense基准，包含刻意违背常识的反直觉图文对，以此降低统计偏差的有效性，迫使模型依赖视觉证据进行推理。
AI.result: 对多种开源和闭源MLLM的全面评估显示，最强闭源模型准确率仅约60%，而人类参与者达到96.04%，存在巨大性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态大模型在真实的视觉理解上仍有困难，突显了发展基于图像内容的鲁棒多模态推理的必要性。

title: PURE: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Multi-Granularity Multimodal Identity Matching
summary: Identity matching asks whether two records denote the same identity, yet the answer depends on the target granularity. Two records may match at the base level but not at the variant level: they share an underlying design while differing in attributes such as color or size. Final matching accuracy does not separately characterize the capabilities involved. To study this problem, we use e-commerce as a challenging real-world domain. We introduce PURE, a diagnostic benchmark for multi-granularity multimodal identity matching covering four capability dimensions: Perception, Understanding, Reasoning, and Evidence-grounded Judgment. The benchmark comprises 1,457 multiple-choice questions across 14 tasks, derived from real-world matching pairs and verified by two domain experts. Across ten recent MLLMs, overall scores range from 47.1% to 86.0%. Understanding receives the highest mean score and Judgment the lowest, with weaknesses in visual difference localization and variant-level rule judgment. Modality ablations show that models benefit from multimodal evidence but can incorrectly identify conflicts between matching records. In direct matching, most models recognize matching pairs more reliably than non-matching pairs at the base level, whereas the reverse holds at the variant level. PURE therefore reveals what aggregate matching accuracy hides: not only whether models judge a pair correctly, but where they struggle to interpret evidence and apply matching criteria.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PURE基准，通过细分感知、理解、推理和判断四个维度来评估多粒度多模态身份匹配，揭示了聚合准确率掩盖的具体能力缺陷。
AI.motivation: 传统的最终匹配准确率无法单独刻画模型在不同匹配粒度（如基础级与变体级）和不同能力维度上的表现，掩盖了模型在解释证据和应用匹配标准时的具体困难。
AI.method: 提出PURE诊断基准，利用真实电商领域的匹配对构建包含4个能力维度、14个任务、1,457个多选题的多模态测试集，对最新多模态大模型进行评估。
AI.result: 十个最新多模态大模型测试总分在47.1%至86.0%之间；理解能力得分最高，判断能力最低；模型在视觉差异定位和变体级规则判断上较弱，且在基础级和变体级对匹配与非匹配对的识别可靠性表现出相反趋势。
AI.conclusion: PURE基准不仅评估了模型判断匹配的准确性，还揭示了聚合准确率背后模型在解释证据和应用匹配标准方面的具体短板，为未来模型改进提供了明确方向。
